name: bare-fist
unmodelled: fight_calc runs the retired ward model (pass and drain shares, body guard); CONSTANT_DRIFT on 31 of 60 constants (health_units 16 vs 64, regen_base 0.02 vs 0.035, art lint 12 vs 24). Every number here is an observation on old rules

Stored Breath (overflow banks +0.10 basic coefficient per 1 % of maximum linh luc lost to a full pool, cap +1.2, spent by the next basic attack): approximated as L5 +40 while the pool is full (guard above 0.55 of qi_max = full usable pool after 0.42 reserved). The real piece adds to the coefficient, not L5
basic_speed_pct +50 (basic_cooldown 1 s -> 0.667 s): fight_calc fixes the basic attack at 1 s. Damage per second from the basic is understated by a third
basic_coef_add: expressed as basic c 2.2 (1.0 + 1.2 flat)

Layered wards in art and ward slots (Common Ward, Qi-Scattering Robe, Fire-Shunning Veil, Mountain Screen, Thousand-Layer Cloud, Iron Shirt, Clear Heart Ward, Soul-Guarding Lamp): approximated as one drain ward passing 0.10 at the drain floor 0.15 and evade 31 %. Points resistance (890 at ws 160), block 461 points, ward shields 4,131 and the reserved-ward payloads are not modelled
Closed Hand (ward efficiency +100 with no damaging art): folded into the drain floor; not separately removable
Quiet Channels (+0.5 pp regeneration per art slot holding no art, cap +3 pp): folded into regen_bonus_pct; fight_calc also caps regeneration at regen_cap 0.08, which the GDD retired

Settled Dust (Earth buff stacks from basic hits, Physical damage taken dampened), Still Water (overflow heals), Unyielding Breath (refuse Down once), Elemental Fist ([earth] tag for scopes): not modelled
Steady Breath and Full Sea read linh luc as a share of qi_max in fight_calc; the sheet reads them as shares of the usable maximum (thresholds 0.50 and 0.80 of 0.58 usable = 0.29 and 0.46 of qi_max)
v1 basic attack {"c": 2.2, "kind": "body", "x": [66, 300, 0, 150, 0]} (the basic attack is always coefficient 1.0, Physical)
v1 ward shape {"pass": {"body": 0.1, "qi": 0.1}, "drain": {"body": 0.15, "qi": 0.15}} (pass and drain shares are retired; modelled as the Common Ward at this ws and we, every ward layer at cap)
_comment: Migrated from fight_calc.py format v1 by tools/design/combat_sim/migrate_fight_v1.py (2026-11-11). Art kinds: qi -> elem, body -> phys, no element stacks. Costs kept (post-#44 file). Ward: v1 ws and we kept, every ward layer at cap (top-end build). Everything with no new field is in unmodelled, prefixed v1.
